# Agent Guidance

Scope: this file applies to the whole repository.

## Working Rules

- Keep changes small and directly tied to the task.
- Keep source, tests, public docs, benchmark reports, generated runtime, and local runtime data in their own lanes.
- Do not hand-edit generated plugin runtime files; update source and rebuild when runtime changes are required.
- Preserve memory safety invariants: ambiguous or high-risk memory writes require explicit review and hash-checked approval.
- Do not commit `.cyrene/`, `.env*`, private memory content, or local benchmark output.

## Generated Files

- `plugin/runtime/cyrene-continuity.mjs` is generated by `npm run build:plugin`.
- `src/codex/codex-ui-static.generated.ts` is generated by the UI build pipeline.

## Verification

- Documentation-only changes: `git diff --check`.
- Source or test changes: `npm test` and `npm run typecheck`.
- Plugin runtime changes: run `npm run build:plugin`, then confirm generated diffs are expected.
- Benchmark changes: run the relevant focused benchmark tests before broader verification.
